public_rationale: The March 8 review summary supplied substantive findings favorable to Altman and critical of the former board's process. That defeats the ordinary reading that every public development favored Marcus's position. It does not establish that the board's candor concerns were unfounded.
limitations: OpenAI published the summary of a review commissioned by its own board.
The result depends on reading the sentence as a claim about public evidence rather than an unverifiable account of Marcus's personal impression.

from_speaker: has seemed to support my take and undermine Kara’s
our_interpretation: Read as a claim about the direction of public evidence following the November 2023 firing dispute, through publication on May 29, 2024.

The ordinary reading is that no material public finding favored Altman or criticized the former board's handling of the dispute. This does not require deciding whether firing him was ultimately justified.
The word 'seemed' qualifies Marcus's assessment, but the surrounding passage presents an objectively checkable claim that the evidence consistently favored his position.
criteria.support_condition: The material public evidence during the specified period consistently supports the former board's concerns and supplies no substantive finding favoring Altman's defense.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one substantive public finding during the period favors Altman's defense or challenges the former board's handling of the dispute.
